label: Act of esse at the very cause of the meditator's representation of INFINITE_3
meaning: Extend the existing Meditation III result by applying actuality-to-being to its cause in the represented respect. The positive two-being control grants the full bundle while the meditator surpasses the cause at esse. The omission control retains all four Cartesian premises and a meditator with esse while the cause lacks esse. The weaker distinct-possessor endpoint uses occurrence and content independently of the bearer clause. A separate two-state mathematical control changes which lengths are accepted above every bound by changing a finite output rule. It illustrates determinate positive content in an unbounded domain; its subject matter is unary lengths.
